BiblicalUsage: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the removal is the whole story in one line: Amasa's body pushed out of the road, and the army that had stopped to stare walks on, and the pursuit resumes over the man who delayed it.
